name: Ruy Lopez
idea: Puts immediate pressure on the c6 knight defending Black's central e5 pawn.

name: Italian Game
idea: Rapid development targeting the fragile f7 square while preparing kingside castling.

name: Giuoco Piano
idea: Symmetric, classical development emphasizing center control and king safety.

name: Fried Liver Attack
idea: Sharp, aggressive tactical strike overloading Black's vulnerable f7 pawn.

name: Sicilian Defense
idea: Asymmetric counter-attack fighting for the d4 square without mirroring White's pawn.

name: Sicilian Defense: Open
idea: White opens the center for piece activity; Black enjoys half-open c-file and queenside counterplay.

name: French Defense
idea: Solid, resilient pawn chain with immediate plans to strike at White's center with ...d5.

name: Caro-Kann Defense
idea: Prepares ...d5 with a sound pawn structure while keeping the light-squared bishop unobstructed.

name: Queen's Gambit
idea: Offers a flank pawn to divert Black's central d5 pawn and dominate the board center.

name: Queen's Gambit Declined
idea: Firmly reinforces d5 pawn, setting up a tenacious, deeply defensive structure.

name: Queen's Gambit Accepted
idea: Black surrenders the center temporarily to rapidly develop pieces and target White's e4/c4 squares.

name: Slav Defense
idea: Reinforces d5 with the c-pawn without trapping the c8 bishop behind the e6 pawn.

name: King's Indian Defense
idea: Hypermodern strategy conceding central space early to launch a crushing kingside counterattack.

name: Nimzo-Indian Defense
idea: Pins White's knight to restrain e4 and inflict doubled pawns on the c-file.

name: English Opening
idea: Flank opening exerting dynamic pressure on the central d5 square without committing central pawns.

name: Scandinavian Defense
idea: Directly challenges White's e4 pawn on move one, opening central lines immediately.

name: Pirc Defense
idea: Flexible, indirect defense allowing White central pawns before undermining them with flank pawn breaks.

name: London System
idea: Robust, harmonious setup developing the dark-squared bishop outside the pawn chain before playing e3.

name: King's Gambit
idea: Romantic era gambit sacrificing the f-pawn for rapid kingside piece activity and open f-file.

name: Vienna Game
idea: Quiet move protecting e4 while keeping options open for f4 or Bc4.

name: Scotch Game
idea: Immediate center breakthrough on d4 forcing open files and active piece diagonals.

name: Four Knights Game
idea: Classical harmonious minor piece development with symmetrical center control.
